"""Development-only detector batching probe; no application defaults are modified."""
import gc,hashlib,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import cv2,numpy as np,torch
from app.tracking.detect import DetectorConfig,make_detector
out=Path('.cache/detector-batch-day-development-v1'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
video=Path('data/tracking/bench/daylight_117093/source/seg_0003.mp4'); cap=cv2.VideoCapture(str(video)); frames={}
for f in [0,374,686]:
 cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES,f); ok,img=cap.read(); assert ok; frames[f]=cv2.cvtColor(img,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
cap.release(); reports=[]
for batch in [26,28,11,14]:
 cfg=DetectorConfig(model='small',weights='data/tracking/models/rfdetr_mixed_small',tiles=4,backend='torch',batch_size=batch); start=time.perf_counter(); det=make_detector(cfg); calls=[]; original=det._predict_batch
 def measure(images):
  calls.append(len(images)); return original(images)
 det._predict_batch=measure
 det.detect(frames[0]); torch.cuda.synchronize(); prep=time.perf_counter()-start; calls.clear(); rows=[]
 for repeat in range(2):
  for f,img in frames.items():
   torch.cuda.synchronize(); start=time.perf_counter(); d=det.detect(img); torch.cuda.synchronize(); elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
   payload=dict(xyxy=d.xyxy.tolist(),confidence=d.confidence.tolist(),class_id=d.class_id.tolist()); serialized=json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True); (out/f'batch-{batch}-repeat-{repeat}-frame-{f}.json').write_text(serialized)
   rows.append(dict(repeat=repeat,frame=f,seconds=elapsed,count=len(d),sha256=hashlib.sha256(serialized.encode()).hexdigest()))
 report=dict(batch=batch,prepared_batch=det._fixed_batch,preparation_seconds=prep,calls=calls,rows=rows,mean_seconds=float(np.mean([r['seconds'] for r in rows]))); reports.append(report); (out/f'batch-{batch}-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
 del det,original; gc.collect(); torch.cuda.empty_cache()
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(video=str(video),video_sha256=hashlib.sha256(video.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),scope=__doc__,runs=reports),indent=2))
